verses.en: And seeing the multitudes, he went up into a mountain: and when he was set, his disciples came unto him:
verses.sm: Ua silasila atu ia i le motu o tagata, ona maliu ae lea o ia i le mauga; ua nofo ai i lalo, ona o mai ai lea o ona soo ia te ia;

verses.en: And he opened his mouth, and taught them, saying,
verses.sm: ua ia fetalai atu, ma aʻoaʻo ia te i latou,

verses.en: Blessed are the poor in spirit: for their's is the kingdom of heaven.
verses.sm: “Amuia e matitiva i le agaga; aua e o latou le malo o le lagi.

verses.en: Blessed are they that mourn: for they shall be comforted.
verses.sm: “Amuia ë faanoanoa; aua e faamafanafanaina i latou.

verses.en: Blessed are the meek: for they shall inherit the earth.
verses.sm: “Amuia ë agamalu; aua e fai mo latou tofi le nuu.

verses.en: Blessed are they which do hunger and thirst after righteousness: for they shall be filled.
verses.sm: “Amuia è fia aai ma fia inu i le amiotonu; aua e maoona i latou.

verses.en: Blessed are the merciful: for they shall obtain mercy.
verses.sm: “Amuia ē alolofa atu; auā e alofaina mai i latou.

verses.en: Blessed are the pure in heart: for they shall see God.
verses.sm: “Amuia e loto mama; auā latou te iloa atu le Atua.

verses.en: Blessed are the peacemakers: for they shall be called the children of God.
verses.sm: “Amuia E faatupuina le filemu; auā e taʻua i latou ọ atalii o le Atua.

verses.en: Blessed are they which are persecuted for righteousness' sake: for their's is the kingdom of heaven.
verses.sm: Io “Amuia E sauaina ona o le amiotonu; auā e o latou le malo o le lagi.

verses.en: Blessed are ye, when men shall revile you, and persecute you, and shall say all manner of evil against you falsely, for my sake.
verses.sm: “Amuia outou pe a latou upu leaga, ma faasaua ia te outou, ma latou tuuaiina pepelo outou i mea leaga uma ona o aʻu.

verses.en: Rejoice, and be exceeding glad: for great is your reward in heaven: for so persecuted they the prophets which were before you.
verses.sm: Ia outou olioli ma fiafia lava; auā o i le lagi lo outou taui e tele; auā na faa3 pea ona latou faasaua i perofeta e na muamua ia te outou.

verses.en: Ye are the salt of the earth: but if the salt have lost his savour, wherewith shall it be salted? it is thenceforth good for nothing, but to be cast out, and to be trodden under foot of men.
verses.sm: “O outou, o le masima o le lalolagi ourou; a e afai e magalo le masima, pe se a se mea e faamaái a‘i? E leai se mea e toe aoga ai, na ona lafoaiina i fafo, ma solia e tagata.

verses.en: Ye are the light of the world. A city that is set on an hill cannot be hid.
verses.sm: “O outou, o le malamalama o le lalolagi outou. E le mafai ona lilo le aai ua tu i luga o le mauga.

verses.en: Neither do men light a candle, and put it under a bushel, but on a candlestick; and it giveth light unto all that are in the house.
verses.sm: Latou te le tútúina foi le moli i le tuu ai i lalo o le mea e fua afi saito, a e tuu i luga lava o le tuugámoli ia pupula atu ai i e o i le fale uma.

verses.en: Let your light so shine before men, that they may see your good works, and glorify your Father which is in heaven.
verses.sm: Ia faapea ona pupula atu lo outou malamalama i luma o tagata, ina ia latou. iloa la outou amio lelei, latou te vivii atu ai i lo outou Tama o i le lagi.

verses.en: Think not that I am come to destroy the law, or the prophets: I am not come to destroy, but to fulfil.
verses.sm: “Aua neʻi outou manatu ua ou sau e tatalaina le tulafono po o le au perofeta; ou te lei sau e tatalaina, a ia faataunuuina.

verses.en: For verily I say unto you, Till heaven and earth pass, one jot or one tittle shall in no wise pass from the law, till all be fulfilled.
verses.sm: Auā e moni, ou te fai atu ia te outou, e mavae atu le lagi ma le lalolagi, a e le mavae atu lava se iota po o sina fāsi mataitusi o le tulafono, seia taunu1 mea uma.

verses.en: Whosoever therefore shall break one of these least commandments, and shall teach men so, he shall be called the least in the kingdom of heaven: but whosoever shall do and teach them, the same shall be called great in the kingdom of heaven.
verses.sm: O lenei, o se na te tatalaina se poloaiga e tasi e aupito itiiti o nei poloaiga, ma faapea ona aʻoaʻo i tagata, e taʻua ia e aupito itiiti i le malo o le lagi; a o se anaana ma aʻoaʻo ai, e taʻua ia e sili i le malo o le lagi.

verses.en: For I say unto you, That except your righteousness shall exceed the righteousness of the scribes and Pharisees, ye shall in no case enter into the kingdom of heaven.
verses.sm: Auā ou te fai atu ia te outou, a le sili la outou amiotonu i la le au tusiupu ma le au faresaio, e le sao atu lava outou i le malo o le lagi.

verses.en: Ye have heard that it was said by them of old time, Thou shalt not kill; and whosoever shall kill shall be in danger of the judgment:
verses.sm: “Ua outou faalogo, na fai mai i e anamua, Aua e te fasioti tagata; ai se fasioti tagata, e nofo sala o ia i le faamasinoga.

verses.en: But I say unto you, That whosoever is angry with his brother without a cause shall be in danger of the judgment: and whosoever shall say to his brother, Raca, shall be in danger of the council: but whosoever shall say, Thou fool, shall be in danger of hell fire.
verses.sm: A o aʻu, ou te fai atu ia te outou, ai se ita i lona uso, e nofo sala o ia i le faamasinoga; ai se fai atu foi i lona uso, Raka, e nofo sala o ia i le fono; ai se fai atu foi, Le vale e, e nofo sala o ia i le afi o Kena.

verses.en: Therefore if thou bring thy gift to the altar, and there rememberest that thy brother hath ought against thee;
verses.sm: Pe afai foi e te avatu lau taulaga i le fata faitaulaga, ona e manatua ai lea ua i lou uso se mea e tiga ai o ia ia te oe,

verses.en: Leave there thy gift before the altar, and go thy way; first be reconciled to thy brother, and then come and offer thy gift.
verses.sm: ina tuu ia i lea mea o lau taulaga i luma o le fata faitaulaga, a e alu oe ia muai faalelei i lou uso, i le e sau ai, ma avatu lau taulaga.

verses.en: Agree with thine adversary quickly, whiles thou art in the way with him; lest at any time the adversary deliver thee to the judge, and the judge deliver thee to the officer, and thou be cast into prison.
verses.sm: Ia vave ona oulua lelei ma le o tagi i ana mea ua ia te oe, manù O i le ala oulua ma ia; ina neʻi tuuina atu oe i le faamasino e le ua tagi i ana mea, e tuuina atu foi oe e le faamasino i le auauna, ona tuuina atu lea o oe i le fale puipui.

verses.en: Verily I say unto thee, Thou shalt by no means come out thence, till thou hast paid the uttermost farthing.
verses.sm: E moni, ou te fai atu ia te oe, e te le toe ulufafo ai lava, seia e avatu tupe uma lava.

verses.en: Ye have heard that it was said by them of old time, Thou shalt not commit adultery:
verses.sm: “Ua outou faalogo, na fai mai i e anamua, Aua e te mulilua.

verses.en: But I say unto you, That whosoever looketh on a woman to lust after her hath committed adultery with her already in his heart.
verses.sm: A ou te fai atu a'u ia te outou, ai se vaai atu i le fafine ina ia manao i ai, ua uma ona mulilua ma ia i lona loto.

verses.en: And if thy right eye offend thee, pluck it out, and cast it from thee: for it is profitable for thee that one of thy members should perish, and not that thy whole body should be cast into hell.
verses.sm: Afai foi e te tausuai i lou mata taumatau, ina sali ese ia, ma e lafoai; aua e lelei ina fano se tasi ou fási tino, a e leaga pe a lafoina lou tino uma i Kéna.

verses.en: And if thy right hand offend thee, cut it off, and cast it from thee: for it is profitable for thee that one of thy members should perish, and not that thy whole body should be cast into hell.
verses.sm: Afai foi e te tausuai i lou lima taumatau, ina tutù ese ia, ma e lafoai; aua e lelei ina fano se tasi ou fasi tino, a e leaga pe a lafoina lou tino uma i Kéna.

verses.en: It hath been said, Whosoever shall put away his wife, let him give her a writing of divorcement:
verses.sm: “Sa fai mai foi, At se faatea i ‘ino‘ino i le ua ita mai ia te oe. lana ata, ia avatu ia te ia le tusi alei.

verses.en: But I say unto you, That whosoever shall put away his wife, saving for the cause of fornication, causeth her to commit adultery: and whosoever shall marry her that is divorced committeth adultery.
verses.sm: A ou te fai atu au ia te outou, ai se faatea lana avā, a e lei mulilua ia, ua ia faamulilua ia te ia; ai se fai mana ava le ua faateaina, ua mulilua foi o ia.

verses.en: Again, ye have heard that it hath been said by them of old time, Thou shalt not forswear thyself, but shalt perform unto the Lord thine oaths:
verses.sm: “Ua faalogo foi outou, na fai mai i e anamua, Aua e te tauto pepelo; a ia e avatu i le Alii o mea e te tauto ai.

verses.en: But I say unto you, Swear not at all; neither by heaven; for it is God's throne:
verses.sm: A ou te fai atu aʻu ia te outou, aua lava ne‘i tauto; aua le tauto i le lagi, aua o le nofoalii lea o le Atua;

verses.en: Nor by the earth; for it is his footstool: neither by Jerusalem; for it is the city of the great King.
verses.sm: po.o le lalolagi, auā o le mea e tu ai ona aao lea; po o Ierusalema, aua o le aai lea a le Tupu silisili.

verses.en: Neither shalt thou swear by thy head, because thou canst not make one hair white or black.
verses.sm: Aua foi neʻi e tauto i lou ulu, aua e te le mafaia ona faasinasina, pe faauliuli se lauulu e tasi.

verses.en: But let your communication be, Yea, yea; Nay, nay: for whatsoever is more than these cometh of evil.
verses.sm: A ia faapea la outou upu, loe, ioe; E leai, e leai; aua o le upu e sili i na upu, mai le leaga lava ia.

verses.en: Ye have heard that it hath been said, An eye for an eye, and a tooth for a tooth:
verses.sm: “Ua outou faalogo, na fai mai, E suia le mata i le mata, e suia foi le mifo i le nifo.

verses.en: But I say unto you, That ye resist not evil: but whosoever shall smite thee on thy right cheek, turn to him the other also.
verses.sm: A ou te fai atu aʻu ia te outou, aua ne“ outou tetee atu i le leaga; ai se na te po mai i lou alafau taumatau, ia e liliu atu ia te ia le isi.

verses.en: And if any man will sue thee at the law, and take away thy coat, let him have thy cloke also.
verses.sm: O lē fia fai se faamasinoga ma oe e ave lou ofu tino, ia e tuu atu foi i ai ma lou ofu tele.

verses.en: And whosoever shall compel thee to go a mile, go with him twain.
verses.sm: Ai se na te tauanau mai lua te o ma ia i le maila e tasi, ina o ia oulua ma ia i maila e lua.

verses.en: Give to him that asketh thee, and from him that would borrow of thee turn not thou away.
verses.sm: Ia e avatu i le ua ole mai ia te oe; aua foi e te liliu ese i le ua fia nond tupe ia te oe.

verses.en: Ye have heard that it hath been said, Thou shalt love thy neighbour, and hate thine enemy.
verses.sm: “Ua outou faalogo, na fai mai, Ia e alofa atu i lē lua te tuaoi a ia A ou

verses.en: But I say unto you, Love your enemies, bless them that curse you, do good to them that hate you, and pray for them which despitefully use you, and persecute you;
verses.sm: te fai atu aʻu ia te outou, ia outou alolofa atu i e ua ita mai ia te outou, ia outou tatalo foi mo e ua faasaua mai ia te outou;

verses.en: That ye may be the children of your Father which is in heaven: for he maketh his sun to rise on the evil and on the good, and sendeth rain on the just and on the unjust.
verses.sm: ina ia faia outou ma atalii o lo outou Tamā o i le lagi, o le na te faaoso i lona la i e ua amio leaga atoa ma e ua amio lelei; ua ia faatotō ifo foi le ua i e ua amiotonu, atoa ma e ua amioletonu.

verses.en: For if ye love them which love you, what reward have ye? do not even the publicans the same?
verses.sm: Auā afai tou te alolofa atu i e ua alolofa mai ia te outou, sc a ea se taui tou te maua ai? E le faia ea e tagata ao lafoga o lea lava mea?

verses.en: And if ye salute your brethren only, what do ye more than others? do not even the publicans so?
verses.sm: Pe afai tou te faapito lo outou fealofani i o outou uso, se a se mea sili ua outou faia? E le faapea ea ona faia e tagata faapaupau?

verses.en: Be ye therefore perfect, even as your Father which is in heaven is perfect.
verses.sm: O lenei, ia atoatoa ona lelei o la outou amio, e pei o lo outou
